# Independent all-model scalar operator fixtures

`operators/manifest.json` contains 17 captures generated by the original C#
`InferenceSession` with one worker, hardware intrinsics/NHWC/fusion disabled.
It extends the retained recognition-v1 fixtures without replacing them.

The normal Rust gate executes 15 cases and compares every captured canonical
node and final output. Coverage includes row-scalar Sub/Div, native Pow(2) and
Sqrt, trailing-axis mean, dynamic rank-four attention MatMul/Softmax, broadcasted
MatMul, rank-five QKV Slice/Squeeze, two complete unfused LayerNorm cases, and
retained integer Shape/Identity/Slice/Squeeze/Unsqueeze/Concat programs at two
bound widths. The near-constant LayerNorm case exercises cancellation and
epsilon stabilization.

Copies, means, subtraction/division and MatMul cases declare exact output bits.
Pow/Sqrt/Softmax/LayerNorm use `atol=1e-5`, `rtol=1e-4`. Native Pow(2) uses
`MathF.Pow`; the portable Rust square uses multiplication, so no bitwise Pow
identity is claimed. Two additional data Slice captures with steps 2 and -2
are preserved as explicit rejection tests: the shipped runtime subset supports
unit-step data Slice. This is shipped-model coverage, not general ONNX support.

The embedded fixture source and native assembly identity are recorded in the
manifest. Regenerate into a new directory, with the repository as the working
directory:

```powershell
dotnet build tools/reference-export/ReferenceExport.csproj -c Release
$env:DOTNET_PROCESSOR_COUNT = '1'
$env:DOTNET_EnableHWIntrinsic = '0'
$env:PPOCR_NHWC = '0'
$env:SIMD_OCR_NOFUSE = '1'
$env:PPOCR_DET_THREADS = '1'
dotnet tools/reference-export/bin/Release/net10.0/SimdPaddleOCR.ReferenceExport.dll --export-scalar-rec-ops --out target/recognition-scalar-operators-new
cargo test --release --locked --offline --test rec_operator_goldens
```
